summary: Iteration 2: validated password reset, email verification, admin RBAC, Stripe checkout fund, holdings, and all new UI flows. Backend 40/40 pytest pass (23 new + 17 regression). Frontend: logo 64px confirmed, both PlanExplainer sections render, /auth/forgot dev token flow works, /admin Restricted-area + admin stats/tables work, /fund/<slug> page renders with 3 payment methods + Continue button, Dashboard 'Verify your email' banner + 'No holdings yet.' empty state both correct. One frontend UX bug found in EmailVerify.jsx (StrictMode double-fire shows 'Verification failed' even though email IS actually verified on the backend). Binance WS fails from the test sandbox (expected, non-blocking per request).

ui_bugs.issue: Page renders 'Verification failed. Invalid or used token' on success because the verification POST is fired twice by React 18 StrictMode useEffect. First call returns 200 (and email_verified becomes true on backend), second call returns 400 'Invalid or used token' and that error state is what the user sees. Fix: guard the POST with a useRef sentinel or treat 400 as a soft success and re-fetch /auth/me to confirm. Confirmed via reproduction: two sequential POSTs to /api/auth/email/verify/confirm with the same fresh token return (200, 400) and /auth/me shows email_verified=true.

integration_issues.issue: wss://stream.binance.com:9443/stream handshake fails from the preview sandbox (geographical/CORS restriction in this environment). LIVE indicator therefore not visible during automated test runs. Backend /api/market/crypto fallback still works. Non-blocking per review_request, but real users from blocked geographies will also see no 'LIVE' tag — consider a server-side WS proxy or a polling fallback that lights the LIVE pill.

issues: Recharts emits 16+ 'width(-1) and height(-1) of chart should be greater than 0' warnings on dashboard and live-market panel. Cosmetic only — likely a flexbox container with no explicit min-height during initial mount. Wrap charts in a div with minHeight set.

action_items: Fix EmailVerify.jsx StrictMode double-fire: guard the verify POST behind a useRef so it runs once, or interpret a 400 'Invalid or used token' as success when /auth/me confirms email_verified=true.
(Optional) Investigate Binance WS reachability from the preview origin / add a backend WS proxy so the LIVE indicator works in regions that block stream.binance.com.
(Cosmetic) Set explicit min-height on Recharts ResponsiveContainer wrappers to silence the width(-1)/height(-1) warnings on dashboard and live-market panel.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is now ~900 lines and crossing the 700-line guideline. Recommend splitting into routes/auth.py, routes/checkout.py, routes/admin.py, routes/market.py with a shared deps.py for current_user + Mongo handles.

STRIPE_API_KEY default fallback 'sk_test_emergent' is hardcoded twice (checkout_fund, checkout_status, stripe_webhook). Extract to a module-level constant and remove the inline `or 'sk_test_emergent'` defaults to avoid divergence.
Password reset token TTL is 2 hours and email verify is 48 hours — reasonable. Tokens are single-use via the `used` flag — verified by test_confirm_flow_full.
Admin seed is idempotent (find_one before insert) — good. is_admin defaults to False elsewhere — good.

/api/checkout/status fetches Stripe status on EVERY non-paid call which can be expensive. Consider caching the last status check or rate-limiting client polling. Frontend Dashboard.jsx polls via fund_session_id query param — verify the polling interval is reasonable (3-5s minimum).
Webhook handler at /api/webhook/stripe correctly idempotent-checks payment_status before inserting a Holding. Good.
Admin endpoints decrypt PII on read — correctly gated by Depends(require_admin). 401 vs 403 distinction is correct (unauthed=401, non-admin=403).

context_for_next_testing_agent: All iteration-2 backend functionality is solid — see /app/backend/tests/test_iteration_2.py for the regression suite (run with REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL set). The single open issue is EmailVerify.jsx double-firing under React StrictMode; reproduce by registering a fresh user, hitting Resend on Dashboard, clicking the dev verify link — the page will show 'Verification failed' but a follow-up GET /api/auth/me will show email_verified=true. Stripe checkout sessions get created with payment_status='initiated' and stored in db.payment_transactions; we did not complete a real Stripe payment, so the 'paid → holding created' path was only verified by code review (server.py lines 633-642 and 657-673 are idempotent and look correct).
rca of the issue: RCA — EmailVerify.jsx double-call: Reproduced two sequential POST /api/auth/email/verify/confirm with the same valid token: call1 → 200 {ok:true}, call2 → 400 {detail:'Invalid or used token'}. /auth/me afterwards shows email_verified=true. Cause: React 18 StrictMode in development invokes effects twice on mount; the page's useEffect that posts the token is not guarded. Mitigation options: (a) useRef sentinel to ensure single call; (b) treat 400 'Invalid or used token' as a soft success and refetch /auth/me; (c) move the call out of useEffect into an explicit user-initiated submit. Backend behavior is correct (single-use tokens are a feature).
